rows.grounds: fused form of śuddha-abhāve api aśuddhakam; avagraha marks sandhi between abhāve and api

items.question: What is the status of an impure substance when purity is absent?
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of aśuddhakam remains unresolved.
items.plain_english: Even when purity is absent, the impure substance remains relevant.
